title: Intel UHD Graphics 620 (Kaby Lake-R / 8th-gen mobile)
notes: Reference GPU for the first lab. Memory-bandwidth bound; LPDDR3/DDR4 shared with the CPU. D3D11 is the sweet spot on this part; Vulkan driver support on 8th-gen mobile is inconsistent, and D3D12's explicit model rarely pays off on iGPUs this size.
